summary: Tuya Inc. filed a Form 6-K with exhibits announcing the record date for its forthcoming annual general meeting (AGM) and a next-day disclosure return regarding share capital changes and buybacks. The record date is May 22, 2026, for Hong Kong and Cayman Islands registered ordinary shares and for ADS holders. This is a routine corporate administrative filing related to a shareholder meeting and ordinary share repurchase disclosure; it does not involve a special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or going-private. No deal terms, advisor recommendations, or event-driven structural changes are present. This filing is ordinary-course governance and not a special situation.
